The Senate Bill 553 By: Senators Hatchett of Committee on Regulated Industries and Utilities offered the 50th, Walker III of the 20th, Cowsert of the 46th, Brass of the 6th, Payne of the 54th and others following substitute to SB 553:
A BILL TO BE ENTITLED AN ACT
To amend Title 43 of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated, relating to professions and businesses, so as to repeal Chapter 14, relating to electrical contractors, plumbers, conditioned air contractors, low … established by the State Construction Industry Licensing Board, and meet the following requirements: (1) Successfully pass a board approved examination with a minimum score of 70; (2) Meet eligibility requirements according to one of the following criteria: (A) At least four three years of full-time experience in the electrical field as would be covered by the Georgia Electrical Code, the National Electrical Code, or any successor code, which shall mean working experience gained through the direct installation of electrical systems and directly … the required fees established by the State Construction Industry Licensing Board, and shall meet the following requirements: (1) Successfully pass a board approved examination with a minimum score of 70; (2) Meet one of the following criteria: (A) At least six four years of full-time experience in the electrical field as would be covered by the Georgia Electrical Code, the National Electrical Code, or any successor code of which not less than two years shall have been in the installation, alteration, or … 1697 (C) Tier three: has 300 or fewer employees or $30 million or less in gross receipts per 1698 year."
1699
SECTION 4. 1700 All laws and parts of laws in conflict with this Act are repealed.
